name: Poll Assistant
description: Durable WhatsApp polls for decisions, response measurement, and structured quantity totals.
dataStored: Account-scoped SQLite poll definitions, rounds, options, electorates, private ballot issuance receipts, vote events, materialized ballots, authoritative readbacks, immutable source-lifecycle snapshots, aggregate results, deliveries, and tie resolutions. Poll Assistant working copies of voter-level data are purged after configured retention and terminal delivery; chat-archive copies follow the separate archive policy.

workflows.description: Guided poll setup before the poll lifecycle is durably created.
Durably created poll lifecycles require the explicit poll cancellation command.
workflows.notCancellableReason: A published or queued native poll may already be visible, so cancellation requires the lifecycle-specific confirmed command and durable result delivery.

Open a schedule-deferred automated poll or close a manageable poll through guided selection and confirmation; cancellation and tie resolution remain explicit.
